description: This file is a shell script that sets up and tests Git hook infrastructure for a version control system, including pre-receive, update, post-receive, and post-update hooks. It defines a series of tests to verify hook behaviors, input, and output handling.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs a command or set of commands.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if a given path is a file.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Verifies that a given file or input stream is empty.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files or streams.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of test cases.
